sloka: गोदावरीम् प्रवेक्ष्यामि हीना रामेण लक्ष्मण ।आबन्धिष्ये अथवा त्यक्ष्ये विषमे देहम् आत्मनः ॥३-४५-३६॥
transliteration: godāvarīm pravekṣyāmi hīnā rāmeṇa lakṣmaṇa ।ābandhiṣye athavā tyakṣye viṣame deham ātmanaḥ ॥3-45-36॥

translations.english: At these words of Lakshmana Sita started crying. With eyes filled with tears she replied with harshness :
translations.hindi: फ ७ . लच्मण की ये बातें सुन, शो को उत्तर देते हड कहे
